messages:
emily: Uploaded the latest blog draft and the webinar registration flow. Please read the hero claim and the CTA split before 4pm PT. Link: https://drive.redwood/launch/draft-v3
raj: skimmed. Hero reads strong but the benchmark callout "40–60% lower per-token cost" needs a source or we risk pushback from legal.
maria: agree with raj. Suggest we add a small methodology note: which models, input lengths, and caching assumptions. dev audience cares about exact config.
emily: good point. I added a short footnote and a link to the internal benchmark doc. Also added two CTAs: "Try the Hosted API" and "Book a demo (enterprise)" — want routing rules confirmed.
zack: for webinar embed — can we use the lightweight iframe? I have a clean CTA block that fits hero and below-the-fold. Also propose a 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A in the webinar agenda.
theo: mockups uploaded. Hero image option A (developer-focused) and B (enterprise dashboard). A pairs better with the "Try" CTA, B with "Book a demo". Pinged design for alt text.
emily: routing rules proposal: HubSpot mapping: enterprise leads (company_size>1000 or job_title matches "CTO, VP Eng") -> sales-enterprise queue; otherwise -> inbound-growth queue. Also add utm params: utm_source=launch_post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch
raj: can we add an MQL threshold? e.g., lead_score >= 75 to go straight to AE inbox, otherwise nurture workflow.
emily: yes. I'll add: if lead_score >= 75 AND company_size>100 -> AE; else nurture. Also will add source metadata in contact record: "launch_blog_v3"
maria: quick note on copy variants — can we A/B the hero claim language? Variant 1: "Cut inference bills by up to 50%" Variant 2: "Lower per-token cost for production workloads" — which is less risky legally?
legal-bot: quick-pass: both variants okay if you remove absolute wording like "guarantee" and include the benchmark footnote. The phrasing "up to 50%" is allowable if backed by linked benchmark and timeframe. Please include: "Results may vary depending on workload and configuration." :white_check_mark:
emily: thanks legal-bot. I'll incorporate the exact disclosure line.
zack: webinar embed: need the registration webhook to call `/webhooks/hubspot/launch_2026` and map `webinar_slot -> calendar_team`. Can someone add that to the ops ticket?
emily: created ops ticket GTM-4321 with the webhook details and sample payload:
```
POST /webhooks/hubspot/launch_2026
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "utm_campaign": "dedicated_launch",
  "webinar_slot": "2026-04-12T16:00:00Z",
  "lead_source": "launch_blog_v3"
}
```
maria: perfect. For the CTA copy lock: can we finalize the copy now? I vote: hero CTA = "Try the Hosted API" (primary), secondary = "Book a demo" with analytics tag `cta=book_demo`.
raj: approve copy and routing as long as legal snippet is present. :thumbsup:
emily: noted. Locking copy and CTAs at 4pm PT. I'll coordinate the webinar dry run tomorrow at 9am PT — invite sent to squad and 2 guests.
theo: design will hand off final assets by 2pm PT for integration.
legal-bot: follow-up: legal retains right to request edits; email legal@redwood if additional substantiation needed. No further holds.
emily: great — thanks everyone. Final checklist: add benchmark footnote link, webhook in GTM-4321, creative assets from theo, hubspot mapping, and lock copy. Will post final publish time once dry run completes. :rocket:
